meta.method: Fresh browser context per run; viewport 860×720 at DPR 1; stage 800×600. Warm-up 1 s after the first frame, then a 5 s window (rAF deltas, CDP Performance.getMetrics TaskDuration, SystemInfo.getProcessInfo CPU per process type), then a scripted drag of the top item (30 pointer moves 16 ms apart) while everything animates, then heap after GC. CPU throttle with Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate (renderer main thread). Medians across runs.
